purpose: One fixed alternative to the conservative v3 whole-line fallback, investigated because early v3 regression runs lost substantial timed-word coverage.
exposureBeforeSelection: Earlier v1/v2 evidence, v3 instrumental results, first four v3 vocal text/coverage summaries, and v3 shared Cortez smoke were already known. No raw-timing alternative scores were inspected before defining this policy.
rules: Use the saved actual raw Whisper DTW intervals for words whose native and SDK spans are valid; do not invent intervals for invalid raw evidence.
Keep v3 lexical masking/recovery thresholds exactly: word probability 0.35, weak window -1.0, repetitive compression 2.4, weak-window recovery 0.70 with native support.
A raw/SDK boundary difference greater than 0.20s marks the word and line uncertain; do not shorten or redistribute the raw interval.
Retain existing disjoint-line normalization and non-lyric-caption handling.
Use cached model evidence only. Generate every hypothesis before reading human references. Do not tune on per-song outcomes.
comparison: Text equality or any differences versus frozen v3
Common-word paired start/end errors, including per-song regressions
approval: Evaluation only. Do not change the running frozen v3 benchmark or default service until complete comparison is reviewed and a genuine model/service run validates any accepted change.
